_comment: Known queries the weekly comma check (check.py, search_code.py --answers) asks the comma's search code: search-code.tar unpacked, imported in a separate Python (-I -S) the way StarPilot loads it, over the pack's own search.sqlite (and addresses.sqlite when the pack has one). Each query is asked from 'near' ([lat, lon]; null: no position) and must find a result whose title contains 'title' (case ignored), within 'within_km' of 'at', among the first 'top'. Keyed by the pack's state. A state without queries here is asked for its own most important place by name. Only public places: town centres and the public test trip (I-90 east, exit 24, left on Peach Street, right on Downs Drive in Erie).
